notes.title: Diving Deep: We're Unveiling Underlab at Future Games Show with a Teaser!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44540815/1dcf9bd8cd7ee3ab0253f3e79168cf728cf44753.png[/img]

Hello Gamers,
We've got some seriously exciting news to drop today! It's with immense joy and a touch of suspense that we present to you the official reveal of Underlab at the buzzing Future Games Show during this year’s Gamescom.

[h3]Let's Dive Right In:[/h3]
First off, we want to give a massive shoutout to the Project Winter community for their support in this ride. Today's the day we get to pull back the curtain and show you what we've been cooking up in our game-making cauldron. 

[previewyoutube=wmZuq64MLDo;full]https://youtu.be/wmZuq64MLDo [/previewyoutube]

[h3]Building on the Good Stuff:[/h3]
Underlab is a spiritual sequel to our much-loved title, Project Winter. But we're throwing in a curveball – we're mixing in role-playing, sandbox exploration, and doubling down on “social” in the social deception, all set in an eerie deep-sea lab. 



[h3]Get Social, Stay Alive:[/h3]
In Underlab, we're cranking up the social dynamics to eleven. Your interactions with other players are the heart of the game – trust us, you'll be making frenemies faster than you can say "infiltrator"! But hey, that's where the fun really lies!

[h3]Beta Alert:[/h3]
If sneaky backstabbing sounds like fun, you can be among the first to dive into Underlab and help us fine-tune the experience. You're not just players; you're part of our development crew now!

BETA SIGN UP: https://underlab.game/

Stay tuned, stay hyped, and get ready to dive deep into "Underlab" – where sandbox meets deception and the fun never… sinks!

Catch you on the flip side,
The Other Ocean Team
